pathway.title: Distressed & Restructuring
pathway.question: Is the distress gate met; which path and fulcrum; what recoveries?

runs.text: Downside view: CP-2A assesses TransDigm Group Incorporated (TDG), consolidated, combining the FY2024 static downside screen and absorbed CP-2B historical calendar duties. The first calculable watch is 7.0x carrying-debt / issuer EBITDA As Defined after a hypothetical 14.826606% earnings decline, ahead of the 3.0x cash-interest coverage watch at 16.750539%. Neither is a covenant or default threshold. The combined 20% earnings / 10% cash-interest shock crosses both watches but leaves the operating-cash-less-capex proxy positive at USD929.60m. Aviation demand weakness and unrecovered input costs can first impair sales/margins, then cash conversion; debt service and documented shareholder extraction can amplify refinancing dependence. Confidence is Medium, not High: these are illustrative shocks, not economically calibrated forecasts, and accessible liquidity and legal capacity remain unresolved.

Calendar view: The absorbed CP-2B scope is a historical event-risk reconstruction, not a newly executed annual producer or a current calendar. Six historical monitoring objects cover the period after 2024-11-07 through 2025-11-07, reconstructed on execution date 2026-11-05 from September 30, 2024 terms. July securitization expiry is Critical; March and September hedge transitions and FY2025 principal payments are High monitoring priorities. Scheduled-event occurrence is High, not a high probability of default or adverse outcome. Known hedge replacement terms, conditional facility extensions, annual cash generation and historical refinancing are meaningful counterevidence. This is a historical calendar, not a current watchlist or a statement of realised 2025 outcomes. All six objects are Debt & Capital Structure events; precise dates are ordered separately from overlapping fiscal-year windows.

fields.value: Downside view: CP-2A assesses TransDigm Group Incorporated (TDG), consolidated, combining the FY2024 static downside screen and absorbed CP-2B historical calendar duties. The first calculable watch is 7.0x carrying-debt / issuer EBITDA As Defined after a hypothetical 14.826606% earnings decline, ahead of the 3.0x cash-interest coverage watch at 16.750539%. Neither is a covenant or default threshold. The combined 20% earnings / 10% cash-interest shock crosses both watches but leaves the operating-cash-less-capex proxy positive at USD929.60m. Aviation demand weakness and unrecovered input costs can first impair sales/margins, then cash conversion; debt service and documented shareholder extraction can amplify refinancing dependence. Confidence is Medium, not High: these are illustrative shocks, not economically calibrated forecasts, and accessible liquidity and legal capacity remain unresolved.

fields.value: Calendar view: The absorbed CP-2B scope is a historical event-risk reconstruction, not a newly executed annual producer or a current calendar. Six historical monitoring objects cover the period after 2024-11-07 through 2025-11-07, reconstructed on execution date 2026-11-05 from September 30, 2024 terms. July securitization expiry is Critical; March and September hedge transitions and FY2025 principal payments are High monitoring priorities. Scheduled-event occurrence is High, not a high probability of default or adverse outcome. Known hedge replacement terms, conditional facility extensions, annual cash generation and historical refinancing are meaningful counterevidence. This is a historical calendar, not a current watchlist or a statement of realised 2025 outcomes. All six objects are Debt & Capital Structure events; precise dates are ordered separately from overlapping fiscal-year windows.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: CP-2/CP-1A identify aircraft utilization, airline economics, OEM production and defense budgets as demand drivers, with labor/material/supply constraints potentially preventing cost flex. The first operational break would be weaker orders/sales or adverse mix before the financial watches: margin loss → assumed earnings-to-proxy cash loss → weaker leverage/coverage → greater dependence on funding. Receivables/inventory absorption could accelerate this pathway but is not separately modeled. Hedge transitions expose cash-interest sensitivity; July facility expiry introduces a dated funding question that a static ratio cannot answer. A real failure point would require inaccessible liquidity, inability to fund obligations or failed renewal/refinancing—not merely crossing a watch.

This would gain weight with verified accessible cash, compliant borrowing-base/covenant certificates, cash forecasts and timely renewal/rehedging. It restrains conviction in an adverse outcome, but does not resolve the October distribution's cash effect or current funding capacity. CP-1A's High governance rubric is not a PD, and sponsor identity remains unresolved.

fields.value: K supplies a new deterministic calculation, not a model-loop Python execution or native-owner acceptance. Its F/code hashes match the supplied identities above. The direct BaseOperands approach bypasses the native nine-T4.10-fact offered-period and reported-ratio gates; no typed financial facts were fabricated. Static formulas are E′=E(1−s), I′=I(1+k), P′=P−Es−Ik; total leverage D/E′, mechanical net leverage (D−C)/E′, coverage E′/I′ and proxy/debt P′/D. P denotes OCF-less-capex proxy, never sustainable or issuer-defined FCF. Only incremental interest is deducted: base OCF already includes base cash interest, taxes and working capital.

fields.value: Limitations: This is a bounded static screen plus historical event reconstruction, not a forecast, current liquidity assessment, covenant opinion, rating, PD estimate, recovery or refinancing execution conclusion. There is no tax shield, working-capital/capex response or modeled distribution/acquisition response; the one-for-one earnings-to-proxy reduction is assumed. Reported cash is not established unrestricted cash. No netting or aggregation of overlapping derivative notionals establishes coverage. No later quarter or realised 2025 result is used. Reading extracted text does not constitute visual verification. Confidence remains Medium and below High while the two Critical CP-1A/CP-2 gaps persist.
